purpose: Classify an AI system to its governance tier across EU AI Act (prohibited/high-risk/limited-risk/minimal-risk), NIST AI RMF profile (T1 basic/T2 standard/T3 enhanced), and ISO/IEC 42001 control set (light/standard/enhanced). Identifies GPAI provider status and systemic-risk flag. Terminal node of the ai-management-system-conformance chain. EU AI Act Art. 6-17 enforcement from 2 December 2027, per the Digital Omnibus amendments (June 2026); Art. 50 transparency stays 2 August 2026. Zero network, zero PII.
